caption:
What should I ask before agreeing to a cosmetic procedure?
One question does most of the work: if this does not do what we want, what is the next step?

There are roughly three answers. A named next step with a date to decide on it. An honest pause - "then we stop and look again" - which is also a plan. Or reassurance offered in place of a next step. Two of those are plans. One of them is a mood.

This is not a research finding and there is no percentage attached to it. It is what I listen for in a consultation. Someone who has thought past the good outcome answers quickly. Someone who has not tends to change the subject.

Ask it early, before the price and before the date. Ask for a noun, because a next step has a name and reassurance does not. Then ask when you would know.

None of this is confrontation. It is the second half of the plan.

General education only.

#AestheticConsultation #InformedConsent #PatientQuestions #MedicalAesthetics #KoreanAesthetics
first_comment: "We can always add more" is the answer worth slowing down for - what would count as enough? Comment with the question you wish you had asked at the time.
